senses.gloss: to hang on, to chain. Part. pass. שָׁלוּל. Lam. R. introd. (R. Z’ʿera) כת … שְׁלוּלִים בשלשלאות a troop of old men chained with chains.
to make chain-stitches, to baste, opp. אחה to sew together with fine stitches.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5:3">Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵇ</cite> top <he>על כל המתים הוא שׁוֹלֵל … ומאחה וכ׳</he> for all deceased relatives one may baste the rent after seven days, and sew it after thirty days; <he>ויִשְׁלוֹל יום שביעי וכ׳</he> let him be permitted to baste it on the seventh day &c.; <cite ref="Tractate Semachot 9:3">Treat. S’maḥ. ch. IX</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 22b:15">M. Kat. 22ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 22b:16">Ib.</cite> <he>האשה שׁוֹלַלְתּוֹ וכ׳</he> a woman may baste it immediately (after rending), out of regard for her dignity; <cite ref="Moed Katan 26b">ib. 26ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 26b:14">Ib.</cite> <he>דלא ניתן לשׁוֹלְלוֹ</he> because it is not to be basted (during the seven days); a. e.

senses.gloss: to hang with, decorate with.—Part. pass. מְשׁוּלָּל. Mekh. B’shall., s. 1 מְשׁוּלָּלִין בזיין, v. שָׁלִישׁ.
